{{toc}}This is a list of '''characters in [[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]]''', listed roughly in their appearance in the game. Note that the order in which some of these characters appear in-game depends upon the sequence in which the player completes certain missions.

{{spoiler}}

==Protagonist==
{| class=wikitable
![[File:CarlJohnson-GTASA.png|100px]]<br />'''[[Carl Johnson|Carl "CJ" Johnson]]'''
|'''Carl Johnson''', also known as '''CJ''', is returning to [[Los Santos in GTA III Era|Los Santos]] from [[Liberty City in GTA III Era|Liberty City]]. After arriving at [[Los Santos International Airport]], he is informed that his mother, [[Beverly Johnson]], has died. He misses the funeral but decides to stay and prove his loyalty to his brother [[Sweet|Sean "Sweet" Johnson]] and to the brothers' gang, the [[Grove Street Families]]. Carl then begins to help the Grove Street Families and weaken their rivals, whilst also establishing a business empire throughout the [[San Andreas in GTA III Era|state of San Andreas]].<br />''He is voiced by [[Young Maylay|Christopher "Chris" Bellard a.k.a. Young Maylay]].''
|}

==Main Characters==
{| class=wikitable
!Character
!Range of Missions
!Description
|-
! [[File:FrankTenpenny-GTASA.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[Frank Tenpenny]]'''
| [[In The Beginning (GTA SA)|In The Beginning]] - [[End of the Line]]
|A primary antagonist to the game, '''Tenpenny''' is a police officer with the [[LSPD in GTA III Era|Los Santos Police Department]] and heads up the community policing unit [[C.R.A.S.H.]]. He and partner [[Eddie Pulaski|Edward "Eddie" Pulaski]], who are joined by rookie [[Jimmy Hernandez]], are involved in creating trouble for the gangs of Los Santos and in particular for Carl. Tenpenny frames Carl for the murder of [[Ralph Pendelbury]] and later employs him to tackle the [[Ballas]] and [[Los Santos Vagos]]. Tenpenny later leaves Los Santos and continues to have Carl perform various tasks for him. He later turns on Hernandez and is put on trial. Shortly after his acquittal sparks off a riot, Tenpenny attempts to escape in a [[Firetruck]] but is killed when he drives off a bridge and into [[Grove Street]]. His corpse is later mutilated and stripped by the homeless.<br />''He is voiced by [[Samuel L. Jackson]]''.
|-
![[File:BigSmoke-GTASA.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[Big Smoke|Melvin "Big Smoke" Harris]]'''
| [[Big Smoke (mission)|Big Smoke]] - [[End of the Line]]
|A secondary antagonist to the game, '''Smoke''' is a high-ranking member of the Grove Street Families who lives in [[Idlewood]]. He welcomes Carl's return to the gang and assists Carl in helping the [[Grove Street Families]] return to dominance. However, he does so in a limited way, having secretly joined forces with the [[Ballas]], the Grove Street Families' main rival, in order to become involved in the drugs trade, which gang leader [[Sweet|Sean "Sweet" Johnson]] had refused to do. He also works in league with the [[Los Santos Vagos]], [[Russian Mafia]] and the [[San Fierro Rifa]]. Whilst Carl is away from Los Santos, he becomes the city's drug baron and hides himself in a building in [[Los Flores]]. He is later killed by Carl for betraying the Grove Street Families.<br />''He is voiced by [[Clifton Powell]]''.
|-
![[File:Sweet-GTASA.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[Sweet|Sean "Sweet" Johnson]]'''
| [[Sweet & Kendl]] - [[End of the Line]]
|A deuteragonist to the game, '''Sweet''' is the leader of the [[Grove Street Families]] and the older brother of Carl, their only sister [[Kendl Johnson]], and [[Brian Johnson]]. He has an unnamed girlfriend. Sweet is initially skeptical about Carl's loyalty, blaming him for Brian's death, but eventually accepts his brother back into the gang. He is arrested by the [[LSPD in GTA III Era|police]], before being released after undercover government agent [[Mike Toreno|Michael "Mike" Toreno]] arranged for his release in return for a favour from Carl. He returns to his home in [[Ganton]] and helps re-assert the Grove Street Families' dominance in the area.<br />''He is voiced by [[Faizon Love]]''.
|-
![[File:Ryder-GTASA.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[Ryder|Lance "Ryder" Wilson]]'''
| [[Sweet & Kendl]] - [[Pier 69 (mission)|Pier 69]]
|A tertiary antagonist to the game, '''Ryder''' is a high-ranking member of the [[Grove Street Families]] who lives in Ganton. Although initially embittered, he welcomes Carl's return to the gang and works with Carl to obtain weapons for the gang, stealing them from [[Colonel Fuhrberger]] and a National Guard weapons depot. However, he has secretly followed Smoke's footsteps in joining forces with the [[Ballas]], the Grove Street Families' main rival, and becomes heavily involved in the drugs trade. Ryder is killed by Carl after fleeing from a meeting with [[Loco Syndicate]] muscle-man and [[San Fierro Rifa]] leader [[T-Bone Mendez|"T-Bone" Mendez]], which had been interrupted by Carl and his then accomplice [[Cesar Vialpando]].<br />''He is voiced by [[MC Eiht]]''.
|-
![[File:CesarVialpando-GTASA.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[Cesar Vialpando|Cesar "Ces" Vialpando]]'''
| [[Cesar Vialpando (mission)|Cesar Vialpando]] - [[End of the Line]]
|A tritagonist to the game, '''Cesar''' is the leader of the Mexican-American Hispanic street gang [[Varrios Los Aztecas]] and the boyfriend of Carl's sister [[Kendl Johnson]]. He lives in [[El Corona]]. He later becomes Carl's ally, through his relationship with Kendl, and later helps him in his business adventures. Following the rise of the [[Ballas]] and [[Los Santos Vagos]] and the fall of the [[Grove Street Families]] and the Aztecas, he leaves Los Santos with Kendl and joins Carl in his exile. He introduces Carl to his cousin, [[Catalina]], and later helps Carl re-assert the Grove Street Families dominance in Ganton. He also talks to Carl about proposing to Kendl.<br />''He is voiced by [[Clifton Collins Jr.]].''
|-
![[File:OGLoc-GTASA.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[OG Loc|Jeffrey "OG Loc" Cross]]'''
| [[OG Loc (mission)|OG Loc]] - [[Cut Throat Business]]
|'''Loc''' is an amateur rapper and an associate of the [[Grove Street Families]]. He is imprisoned and released from prison in [[1992]]. Upon his release he starts working for [[Burger Shot]] and begins to employ Carl to help his rap career get started. This includes killing [[Freddy (GTA SA)|Freddy]], a fellow inmate, and [[Alan Crawford|Alan "Scipio" Crawford]], celebrity rapper [[Madd Dogg|Madd Dogg's]] manager. Carl's actions lead to Madd Dogg's career being derailed, allowing Loc to take his place. Loc is later managed by Smoke and finds initial success. However, Carl and Madd Dogg later chase Loc through western [[Los Santos in GTA III Era|Los Santos]] and manage to corner Loc, taking Madd Dogg's rhyme book back after Carl had [[Madd Dogg's Rhymes|stolen]] it for Loc.<br />''He is voiced by [[Jonathan Anderson|Jonathan "Jas" Anderson]]''.
|-
![[File:Catalina-GTASA.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[Catalina]]'''
| [[First Date (GTA SA)|First Date]] - [[Farewell, My Love...]]
|'''Catalina''' is Cesar's cousin who lives in a secluded shack in the [[Fern Ridge]] area. She is usually misandric, making an exception for her boyfriends. She meets Carl in [[Dillimore]] and the two begin to rob several businesses in the countryside. During this time, they begin a relationship, which quickly ends due Catalina's frustration with Carl's obsession for money to bail Sweet out. She finds a new boyfriend, [[Claude]], and leaves [[San Andreas in GTA III Era|San Andreas]] for [[Liberty City in GTA III Era|Liberty City]]. However, she later attempts to win Carl back through phone calls.<br />''She is voiced by [[Cynthia Farrell]]''.<br />''She also appears in [[Grand Theft Auto III]]''.
|-
![[File:TheTruth-GTASA.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[The Truth]]'''
| [[Body Harvest]] - [[End of the Line]]
|'''The Truth''' is an aging pot-growing hippie and conspiracy theorist who lives in [[San Fierro]] and owns a farm [[Leafy Hollow|on the outskirts of town]]. He becomes a friend to Carl when Carl steals a [[Combine Harvester|combine harvester]] and sets fire to his farm's illegal crops. The Truth also introduces Carl to mechanics [[Dwaine|Dwayne]] and [[Jethro]] and electronics expert [[Zero]], later helping Carl become friends with record producer [[Kent Paul|Kent "Pablo" Paul]] and British singer-musician [[Maccer]]. He later has Carl steal a [[jetpack]] from [[Area 69]] and a container of an unknown [[Green Goo|vial of "blob-and-slime"]] due to his interests in conspiracy theory. He later states his admiration for Carl, who has beaten the system.<br />''He is voiced by [[Peter Fonda]].''
|-
![[File:MikeToreno-GTASA.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[Mike Toreno|Michael "Mike" Toreno]]'''
| [[Photo Opportunity]] - [[Home Coming]]
|A quatragonist to the game, '''Toreno''' is an undercover agent for an unknown government agency who becomes involved in the drug trade, alongside nightclub owner [[Jizzy B.]] and [[San Fierro Rifa]] leader [[T-Bone Mendez|"T-Bone" Mendez]]. He briefly serves as Carl's boss through the drug trade, but Carl later attempts to kill Toreno. Despite this, Toreno employs Carl to finish government-related missions and later has Sweet released from prison.<br />''He is voiced by [[James Woods]]''.
|-
![[File:WuZiMu-GTASA.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[Wu Zi Mu|Wu Zi "Woozie" Mu]]'''
| [[Wu Zi Mu (mission)|Wu Zi Mu]] - [[A Home in the Hills]]
|'''Woozie''' is the blind leader of the Mountain Cloud Boys, a sub-sect of the Chinese-American [[San Fierro Triads]], who resides and owns a betting shop in [[Chinatown, San Fierro|Chinatown]], [[San Fierro]]. He meets Carl in a street race, which Carl wins. Woozie later employs Carl to help his boss [[Ran Fa Li|Ran Fa "Farlie" Li]] and to tackle the [[Da Nang Boys]], before pulling of a heist at the [[Mafia]] owned [[Caligula's Palace]] casino in [[Las Venturas]]. Woozie later helps Carl take back rehabilitated rapper [[Madd Dogg|Madd Dogg's]] [[Madd Dogg's Crib|mansion]].<br />''He is voiced by [[James Yaegashi]].''
|-
|}

==Supporting Characters==
{| class=wikitable
!Character
!Range of Missions
!Description
|-
![[File:EddiePulaski-GTASA.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[Eddie Pulaski|Edward "Eddie" Pulaski]]'''
| [[First Mission (GTA SA)|In The Beginning]] - [[High Noon]]
|A quaternary antagonist to the game, '''Pulaski''' is a police officer with the [[LSPD in GTA III Era|Los Santos Police Department]] and is Tenpenny's partner in crime. He trusts Tenpenny and also works alongside C.R.A.S.H. rookie [[Jimmy Hernandez]], constantly interrupting Carl's life. He later kills Hernandez, before being killed by Carl.<br />''He is voiced by [[Chris Penn]].''
|-
![[File:JimmyHernandez-GTASA.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[Jimmy Hernandez]]'''
| [[First Mission (GTA SA)|In The Beginning]] - [[High Noon]]
|'''Hernandez''' is a police officer with the [[LSPD in GTA III Era|Los Santos Police Department]] and the newest member of [[C.R.A.S.H.]], working alongside Tenpenny and Pulaski. He is forced to kill former C.R.A.S.H. member [[Ralph Pendelbury]] to prove his loyalty and later, alongside Tenpenny and Pulaski, interrupt Carl's life on numerous occasions, having him perform various tasks. Hernandez later decides to give evidence against his colleagues, leading to Pulaski killing him.<br />''He is voiced by [[Armando Riesco]].''
|-
![[File:KendlJohnson-GTASA.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[Kendl Johnson]]'''
| [[Sweet & Kendl]] - [[End of the Line]]
|'''Kendl''' is the sister of Carl, elder brother Sweet and younger brother Brian Johnson, and Cesar's girlfriend. Her relationship with Cesar leads to an alliance between Carl and Cesar. She leaves Los Santos for [[Angel Pine]] after the Ballas and Los Santos Vagos take over large parts of the city. She later becomes heavily involved in Carl's business adventures, primarily his [[Doherty Garage|garage]] and the [[Four Dragons Casino]]. She later returns to Los Santos with Cesar, who at one point told Carl that he planned on asking her to marry him.<br />''She is voiced by [[Yolanda Whittaker|Yolanda "Yo-Yo" Whittaker]].''
|-
![[File:Zero-GTASA.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[Zero]]'''
| [[Wear Flowers In Your Hair]] - [[Breaking the Bank at Caligula's]]
|'''Zero''' is a 28-year old electronics expert and owner of the [[Zero RC]] shop in [[San Fierro]], later running the store for new owner Carl. His archenemy is [[Berkley]], owner of [[Top Fun]]. He later provides electronic equipment for a heist at [[Caligula's Palace]], although he is later punched by Carl for putting the heist at risk from [[Las Venturas Police Department|police]] intervention, but is redeemed when Carl helps him force Berkley into leaving town.<br />''He is voiced by [[David Cross]].''
|-
![[File:JizzyB.-GTASA.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[Jizzy B.]]'''
| [[Photo Opportunity]] - [[Ice Cold Killa]]
|'''Jizzy''' is the owner of the [[Jizzy's Pleasure Domes|Pleasure Domes club]] in [[Battery Point]], [[San Fierro]] and is the city's biggest pimp. He is a member of the [[Loco Syndicate]], alongside [[T-Bone Mendez]] and Toreno, which is involved in the manufacturing and supplying of drugs. He employs Carl to stop rivals from stealing drugs and to save Toreno. However, he is later killed by Carl for supplying drugs to the [[Grove Street Families]] and to [[Los Santos in GTA III Era|Los Santos]].<br />''He is voiced by [[Charlie Murphy]].''
|-
![[File:T-BoneMendez-GTASA.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[T-Bone Mendez]]'''
| [[Photo Opportunity]] - [[Pier 69 (mission)|Pier 69]]
|'''Mendez''' is the leader of the [[San Fierro Rifa]] and a member of the [[Loco Syndicate]], alongside Jizzy and Toreno, which is involved in the manufacturing and supplying of drugs. He distrusts Carl but works alongside him to rescue Toreno. He is later killed by Carl and sworn rival Cesar for supplying drugs to the [[Grove Street Families]] and to [[Los Santos in GTA III Era|Los Santos]], and for killing members of the [[Varrios Los Aztecas]].<br />''He is voiced by [[Kid Frost]].''
|-
![[File:KentPaul-GTASA.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[Kent Paul|Kent "Pablo" Paul]]'''
| [[Don Peyote]] - [[End of the Line]]
|'''Paul''' is the record producer of English band [[The Gurning Chimps]], bringing the band to [[San Andreas in GTA III Era|San Andreas]] for publicity. He meets Carl when Carl rescues him and lead band singer [[Maccer]], who had been stranded in the desert. Paul then introduces Carl to disbarred former lawyer and Caligula's Palace casino owner [[Ken Rosenberg|Ken "Rosie" Rosenberg]], allowing Carl to get inside knowledge of Caligula's Palace. Carl later helps Paul escape from mafia don [[Salvatore Leone]], with Paul becoming involved in getting rehabilitated rapper [[Madd Dogg|Madd Dogg's]] career back on track.<br />''He is voiced by [[Danny Dyer]]''.<br />''He also appears in [[Grand Theft Auto: Vice City]].''
|-
![[File:Maccer-GTASA.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[Maccer]]'''
| [[Don Peyote]] - [[End of the Line]]
|'''Maccer''' is the lead singer of British band [[The Gurning Chimps]] and is originally from Manchester in the [[United Kingdom]]. He and Paul are rescued by Carl, having been stranded in the desert, and then again from the clutches of mafia don [[Salvatore Leone]]. Maccer continues to accompany Paul, but is [[Riot (GTA SA)|mocked by Carl and Sweet due to his uncontrollable sexual tendencies]].<br />''He is voiced by [[Shaun Ryder]]''.
|-
![[File:KenRosenberg-GTASA.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[Ken Rosenberg|Ken "Rosie" Rosenberg]]'''
| [[Don Peyote]] - [[End of the Line]]
|'''Rosie''' is a manager to [[Caligula's Palace]], a casino which is owned by three [[Mafia]] families, better known as the mob: the [[Leone Family|Leones]], [[Forelli Family|Forellis]] and [[Sindacco Family|Sindaccos]]. Fearing his own death at the hands of one of the families, he quickly returns to drug use, having only recently become sober. Rosie later employs Carl to prevent a war breaking out between the three families, before eventually escaping with help from Carl. He then becomes an accountant for rapper [[Madd Dogg]].<br />''He is voiced by [[William Fichtner]]''.<br />''He also appears in [[Grand Theft Auto: Vice City]].''
|-
![[File:SalvatoreLeone-GTASA.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[Salvatore Leone]]'''
| [[Freefall]] & [[Saint Mark's Bistro]]
|'''Salvatore''' is the [[Gang Leaders|don]] of the [[Leone Family]] who resides in [[Liberty City in GTA III Era|Liberty City]]. He has invested $5 million in [[Caligula's Palace]] and owns one third of the casino, alongside the [[Forelli Family|Forelli]] and [[Sindacco Family|Sindacco]] families. He employs Carl in order to gain a larger share of the casino, but feels cheated when Carl later pulls off a heist at the casino alongside Woozie and the [[San Fierro Triads]]. Whilst in [[Las Venturas]], he meets his future wife [[Maria Latore]].<br />''He is voiced by [[Frank Vincent]].''<br />''He also appears in [[Grand Theft Auto III]] and [[Grand Theft Auto: Liberty City Stories]]''.
|-
![[File:MaddDogg-GTASA.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[Madd Dogg]]'''
| [[Madd Dogg (mission)|Madd Dogg]] - [[End of the Line]]
|'''Madd Dogg''' is a celebrity rapper from [[Los Santos in GTA III Era|Los Santos]], who resides in a [[Madd Dogg's Crib|mansion]] in [[Mulholland]]. When Carl returns to Los Santos, Dogg is at the height of his career, having just launched his own line of clothing. However, he later begins to suffer from depression after Carl begins to sabotage his career by stealing his rhyme book and killing his manager [[Alan Crawford|Alan "Scipio" Crawford]]. Depressed by these incidents, Dogg later flees to [[Las Venturas]], having gambled away his mansion to [[Los Santos Vagos]] gangster and drug dealer [[Big Poppa]] in exchange for drugs. He attempts to commit suicide but is rescued by Carl, who later becomes his manager and helps rebuild his career. Dogg goes on to release a gold record by the end of [[1992]].<br />''He is voiced by Ice-T''.
|-
|}

==Minor Characters==
{| class=wikitable
!Character
!Range of Missions

|-
![[File:OldReece-GTASA.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[Old Reece]]'''
| [[Ryder (mission)|Ryder]]
|'''Old Reece''' is a barber and owner of [[Old Reece's Hair & Facial Studio]] in [[Idlewood]], [[Los Santos in GTA III Era|Los Santos]]. He is an old friend of the Johnson family. He is seemingly unaware of events going on around him, asking Carl to tell Smoke to get a hair cut, despite Smoke being bald and later deceased. Reece can be found in his barber shop throughout the game.
|-
![[File:BDup-GTASA.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[B Dup|Mark "B Dup" Wayne]]'''
| [[Cleaning the Hood]] & [[Beat Down on B Dup]]
|'''Dup''' is a former member of the [[Grove Street Families]] and drug dealer who resides in [[Ganton]], [[Los Santos in GTA III Era|Los Santos]]; later moving to [[Glen Park]]. He is drifting away from the Grove Street Families, eventually joining the [[Ballas]] after the events of [[The Green Sabre]]. He has also "enslaved" former Grove Street veteran [[Big Bear|Barry "Big Bear" Thorne]], who eventually turns on Dup and enters rehab.<br />''He is voiced by The Game.''
|-
![[File:BigBear-GTASA.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[Big Bear|Barry "Big Bear" Thorne]]'''
| [[Cleaning the Hood]] & [[Beat Down on B Dup]]
|'''Bear''' is one of the oldest members of the [[Grove Street Families]] and a drug addict. He now lives with Dup and acts as his "slave". He later turns on Dup, his drug supplier, and enters rehab, being welcomed back to the Grove Street Families by Carl and [[Sweet]].<br />''He is voiced by [[Kurt Alexander|Kurt "Big Boy" Alexander]]''.
|-
![[File:Emmet-GTASA.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[Emmet]]'''
| [[Nines and AKs]]
|'''Emmet''' is a gun dealer and member of the Seville Boulevard Families, a former ally of the [[Grove Street Families]], residing in [[Willowfield]], [[Los Santos in GTA III Era|Los Santos]]. [[Sweet]] and Smoke stopped buying weapons from Emmet when the families split, although Carl goes to see what weapons Emmet has.<br />''He is voiced by Eugene Jeter Jr.''
|-
![[File:Jose-GTASA.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[Jose (GTA SA)|Jose]]'''
| [[Cesar Vialpando (mission)|Cesar Vialpando]]
|'''Jose''' is a member of the [[Varrios Los Aztecas]] and a dear friend of Cesar. He dislikes the fact that Carl is misbehaving with Cesar when they first meet.
|-
![[File:ColonelFuhrberger-GTASA.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[Colonel Fuhrberger]]'''
| [[Home Invasion]]
|'''Colonel Fuhrberger''' is a retired colonel who resides in [[East Beach]], [[Los Santos in GTA III Era|Los Santos]]. He stores a large quantity of weapons and ammunition in his home, which is later stolen by Carl and [[Ryder]].
|-
![[File:DeniseRobinson-GTASA.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[Denise Robinson]]'''
| [[Burning Desire]]
|'''Denise''' is a member of the [[Grove Street Families]] who resides in [[Ganton]], [[Los Santos in GTA III Era|Los Santos]]. She first meets Carl after he rescues her from a house fire, which Carl had started. She later becomes Carl's girlfriend and can be seen throughout the game whilst on dates.<br />''She is voiced by [[Heather Alicia Simms]].''
|-
![[File:Freddy-GTASA.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[Freddy (GTA SA)|Freddy]]'''
| [[OG Loc (mission)|OG Loc]]
|'''Freddy''' is a member of the [[Los Santos Vagos]] who was an inmate alongside Loc. He is killed by Carl and Loc for spreading rumours that he and Loc had been involved in homosexual activities whilst in prison.
|-
![[File:AlanCrawford-GTASA.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[Alan Crawford|Alan "Scipio" Crawford]]'''
| [[Management Issues]]
|'''Scipio''' is the manager of [[Madd Dogg]] who refuses to become Loc's manager. He is later killed by Carl on orders from Loc.
|-
![[File:LittleWeasel-GTASA.png|100px]]<br />'''[[Little Weasel]]'''
| [[Doberman]]
|'''Little Weasel''' is a member of the [[Ballas]] who is killed by Carl for betraying the [[Grove Street Families]].
|-
![[File:Kane-GTASA.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[Kane]]'''<br />('''front''')
| [[Los Sepulcros]]
|'''Kane''' is a leader member of the Front Yard Ballas, a sub-sect of the [[Ballas]]. He attends the funeral of [[Little Weasel]], where he gets killed by Carl and two [[Grove Street Families]] gang members.
|-
![[File:Derek-GTASA.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[Derek]]'''
| [[Tanker Commander]]
|'''Derek''' is an employee at a gas station in [[Dillimore]], who at one point gives chase to Carl and [[Catalina]] after they steal a tanker full of fuel. 
|-
![[File:Mr.Whittaker-GTASA.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[Mr. Whittaker]]'''
| [[Tanker Commander]]
|'''Mr. Whittaker''' runs the [[Flint County]] [[RS Haul]]. He takes a tanker full of gas from Carl and [[Catalina]]. He later employs Carl to deliver goods across [[San Andreas in GTA III Era|San Andreas]].
|-
![[File:Claude-GTASA.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[Claude]]'''
| [[Wu Zi Mu (mission)|Wu Zi Mu]] & [[Farewell, My Love...]]
|'''Claude''' is a criminal based in [[San Andreas in GTA III Era|San Andreas]]. He is involved in the illegal street racing circuit, also involving Carl, Woozie and Cesar. He later becomes Catalina's boyfriend, with the two leaving for [[Liberty City in GTA III Era|Liberty City]].<br />''He also appears in [[Grand Theft Auto III]]''.
|-
![[File:HelenaWankstein-GTASA.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[Helena Wankstein]]'''
| Sandbox Mode after [[The Green Sabre]]
|'''Helena''' is a lawyer who lives on a farm in [[Flint Range]], [[Flint County]]. She can, depending on the player's choice, become Carl's girlfriend.<br />''She is voiced by [[Bijou Phillips]].''
|-
![[File:KatieZhan-GTASA.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[Katie Zhan]]'''
| Sandbox Mode after [[The Green Sabre]]
|'''Katie''' is a nurse who resides in [[Juniper Hollow]], [[San Fierro]]. She can, depending on the player's choice, become Carl's girlfriend.<br />''She is voiced by [[China Chow]].''
|-
![[File:MichelleCannes-GTASA.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[Michelle Cannes]]'''
| Sandbox Mode after [[The Green Sabre]]
|'''Michelle''' is a mechanic who resides at her [[Michelle's Auto Repair|garage]] in [[San Fierro]]. She can, depending on the player's choice, become Carl's girlfriend.<br />''She is voiced by [[Vanessa Aspillaga]]''.
|-
![[File:Dwaine-GTASA.png|100px]]<br />'''[[Dwaine|Dwayne]]'''
| [[Wear Flowers In Your Hair]] - [[Puncture Wounds]]
|'''Dwayne''' is a mechanic who runs a hot dog van in [[San Fierro]]. [[The Truth]] introduces him to Carl, who employs him at his [[Doherty Garage|garage]] in [[Doherty]], San Fierro.<br />''He is voiced by [[Navid Khonsari]].''<br />''He also appears in [[Grand Theft Auto: Vice City]]''.
|-
![[File:Jethro-GTASA.png|100px]]<br />'''[[Jethro]]'''
| [[Wear Flowers In Your Hair]] - [[Puncture Wounds]]
|'''Jethro''' is a mechanic working for a [[Xoomer]] Gas Station in [[San Fierro]]. [[The Truth]] introduces him to Carl, who employs him at his [[Doherty Garage|garage]] in [[Doherty]], San Fierro.<br />''He is voiced by [[John Zurhellen]].''<br />''He also appears in [[Grand Theft Auto: Vice City]]''.
|-
![[File:Guppy-GTASA.png|100px]]<br />'''[[Guppy]]'''
| [[The Da Nang Thang]] - [[A Home in the Hills]]
|'''Guppy''' is a high-ranking member of the Mountain Cloud Boys, a sub-sect of the [[San Fierro Triads]]. He is Woozie's assistant and helps pull off the heist at [[Caligula's Palace]].
|-
![[File:RanFaLi-GTASA.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[Ran Fa Li|Ran Fa "Farlie" Li]]'''
| [[Ran Fa Li (mission)|Ran Fa Li]] - [[Fish in a Barrel]]
|'''Farlie''' is the leader of the Red Gecko Tong, a business or political affiliation, connected to the [[San Fierro Triads]]. He does not speak, only grunting, although his assistant [[Su Xi Mu]] translates for him. He is [[Wu Zi Mu|Wu Zi Mu's]] superior and has Carl work for him, acting as a decoy to allow him to escape the [[Da Nang Thang]]. He later becomes co-owner of the [[Four Dragons Casino]], alongside Carl and Woozie.<br />Voiced by: [[Hunter Platin]].
|-
![[File:SuXiMu-GTASA.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[Su Xi Mu|Su Xi "Suzie" Mu]]'''
| [[Ran Fa Li (mission)|Ran Fa Li]] & [[Lure (GTA SA)|Lure]]
|'''Suzie''' is Farlie's assistant who translates his grunts into orders for Woozie and Carl.<br />''He is voiced by [[Richard Chang]]''.
|-
![[File:LittleLion-GTASA.png|100px]]<br />'''[[Little Lion]]'''
| [[The Da Nang Thang]]
|'''Little Lion''' is a member of the [[San Fierro Triads]]. He informs Woozie of a freighter being used by the [[Da Nang Boys]]. He and Carl attack the freighter from a helicopter, which is shot down, killing Little Lion.
|-
![[File:TheSnakehead-GTASA.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[The Snakehead]]'''
|[[The Da Nang Thang]]
|'''The Snakehead''' is presumably the leader of the Da Nang Boys, and attempts to arrive in [[San Fierro]] from Vietnam via a cargo ship. After rescuing several Vietnamese hostages from the ship, Carl has a brief swordfight with the Snakehead and kills him.
|-
![[File:BarbaraSchternvart-GTASA.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[Barbara Schternvart]]'''
| Sandbox Mode after [[Yay Ka-Boom-Boom]]
|'''Barbara''' is a police officer who resides in [[El Quebrados]], [[San Fierro]]. She can, depending on the player's choice, become Carl's girlfriend.<br />''She is voiced by [[Danielle Lee Greaves]].''
|-
![[File:JohnnySindacco-GTASA.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[Johnny Sindacco]]'''
| [[Fender Ketchup]] & [[The Meat Business]]
|'''Johnny''' is a leading member of the [[Sindacco Family]], who own the [[Caligula's Palace]] casino in [[Las Venturas]]. He convinces Salvatore to invest $5 million in the casino and later begins to damage slot machines in the [[San Fierro Triads|Triad]]-owned [[The Four Dragons Casino|Four Dragons Casino]]. Carl has him tied to the hood of car and scares him into telling him which [[Mafia]] family he is with, after Johnny tries to mess with Woozie's ventures. He is later targeted by the [[Forelli Family]], although Carl rescues him, although Johnny later dies of a heart attack after recognising Carl.<br />''He is voiced by [[Casey Siemaszko]]''.
|-
![[File:MariaLatore-GTASA.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[Maria Latore]]'''
| [[Freefall]] & [[Saint Mark's Bistro]]
|'''Maria''', also referred to as '''Maria La Torra''', is a waitress at [[Caligula's Palace]] in [[Las Venturas]]. She meets her future husband in Salvatore while he is in [[Las Venturas]] to run the casino.<br />''She is voiced by [[Debi Mazar]].''<br />''She also appears in [[Grand Theft Auto III]] and [[Grand Theft Auto: Liberty City Stories]].''
|-
![[File:Mike-GTASA.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[Mike (GTA SA)|Mike]]'''
| [[Freefall]]
|'''Mike''' is Salvatore's bodyguard for his stay in [[Las Venturas]].
|-
![[File:Tony-GTASA.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[Tony]]'''
| [[Don Peyote]] - [[Freefall]]
|'''Tony''' is a talking parrot who resides at [[Caligula's Palace]] and is Rosie's "only friend".
|-
![[File:MilliePerkins-GTASA.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[Millie Perkins]]'''
| [[Key to Her Heart]]
|'''Millie''' is a croupier at [[Caligula's Palace]]. She resides in [[Prickle Pine]], [[Las Venturas]]. Carl becomes her boyfriend after he kills one of her clients, [[Benny (GTA SA)|Benny]]. She can be killed after the mission. If the player does not kill Millie, she continues to appear during dates.<br />''She is voiced by [[Orfeh]]''.
|-
![[File:Benny-GTASA.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[Benny (GTA SA)|Benny]]'''
| [[Key to Her Heart]]
|'''Benny''' is a client of Millie who is killed by Carl.
|-
![[File:BigPoppa-GTASA.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[Big Poppa]]'''
| [[A Home in the Hills]]
|'''Big Poppa'''' is a drug dealer and member of the [[Los Santos Vagos]]. He takes control of [[Madd Dogg's Crib]] in exchange for drugs. Carl and the [[San Fierro Triads]] later take the mansion back, with Carl killing Big Poppa.
|-
![[File:JimmySilverman-GTASA.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[Jimmy Silverman]]'''
| [[Cut Throat Business]]
|'''Silverman''' is a producer and manager working for [[Blastin' Fools Records]]. He had managed [[Rochell'le]] and [[Madd Dogg]], before working with Loc. Silverman later stops working with Loc after seeing Madd Dogg, ending his rap career.<br />''He is voiced by [[Gary Yudman]]''.
|-
![[File:Gal-GTASA.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[Gal]]'''
| [[Los Desperados]]
|'''Gal''' is a member of the [[Varrios Los Aztecas]] who, alongside Carl, Cesar, [[Hazer]] and [[Sunny]], helps take back [[El Corona]] for the Varrios Los Aztecas.<br />
|-
![[File:Hazer-GTASA.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[Hazer]]'''
| [[Los Desperados]]
|'''Hazer''' is a member of the [[Varrios Los Aztecas]] who, alongside Carl, Cesar, [[Gal]] and [[Sunny]], helps take back [[El Corona]] for the Varrios Los Aztecas.
|-
![[File:Sunny-GTASA.png|100px]]<br />'''[[Sunny]]'''
| [[Los Desperados]]
|'''Sunny''' is a member of the [[Varrios Los Aztecas]] who, alongside Carl, Cesar, [[Gal]] and [[Hazer]], helps take back [[El Corona]] for the Varrios Los Aztecas.
|-
|}

|[[File:RalphPendelbury-GTASA.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[Ralph Pendelbury]]'''<br />('''bottom''')

The pair forces Hernandez, a potential replacement, to kill Pendelbury during [[The Introduction]]. He is mentioned by Tenpenny when he frames Carl for Pendelbury's death.

He is buried by Sindacco thugs during [[The Introduction]], in what is supposedly the [[Mass Grave|mysterious sand burial]] near [[El Castillo del Diablo|the Devil's Castle]].
|-
|'''[[Bobby]]'''
|Bobby is, presumably, a member of the [[Sindacco Family]]. He is mentioned by two Sindacco family gang members in [[The Introduction]], stating he had recently become an open homosexual.
|-
|[[File:BeverlyJohnson-GTASA.png|100px]]<br />'''[[Beverly Johnson]]'''
|Beverly is the mother of the Johnson siblings. She was killed by members of the [[Ballas]] during [[The Introduction]], and was mentioned in a phone conversation between Carl and Sweet. Her funeral takes place whilst Carl and Smoke are driving to the funeral.
|-
|'''[[Brian Johnson]]'''
|Brian was the youngest of the Johnson siblings. He died in [[1987]] and his death is mentioned by Sweet after their mother's funeral, saying that Carl missed both Brian's and Beverly's funerals.

|Big Devil was a member of the [[Grove Street Families]] who died sometime before [[1992]]. He is mentioned by [[Sweet]] whilst at Beverly's funeral.
|-
|'''[[Little Devil]]'''
|Little Devil was a member of the [[Grove Street Families]] who died sometime before [[1992]]. He is mentioned by [[Sweet]] whilst at Beverly's funeral.
|-
|'''[[Tony (GSF)|Tony]]'''
|Tony was a member of the [[Grove Street Families]] who died sometime before [[1992]]. He is mentioned by [[Sweet]] whilst at Beverly's funeral.
|-
|'''[[LB|Alby "LB" Brown]]'''
|LB is a friend of [[Ryder]] who helps Ryder and Carl. He is mentioned by Ryder during [[Home Invasion|a burglary act]], telling Ryder of some weapons and ammunition located at [[Colonel Fuhrberger|Colonel Fuhrberger's]] home in [[East Beach]], [[Los Santos in GTA III Era|Los Santos]].
|-
|'''[[Herbie]]'''
|Herbie is an astral goat mentioned by [[The Truth]], who used the goat as his only vehicle.
|-
|'''[[Berkley]]'''
|Berkley is [[Zero|Zero's]] rival and the owner of the [[Berkleys RC|"Berkley's RC Shop"]] business. Zero mentions Berkley during five missions, with Carl disrupting Berkley's business and defeating him in a miniature war. Zero also mentions Berkley after [[Breaking the Bank at Caligula's|an extremely dangerous heist in Las Venturas]], stating he had told Berkley of the impending heist. Upon hearing this, Carl punches him.
|-
|'''[[General Mills]]'''
|General Mills is an army general who is in charge of the [[Black Project]]. He is mentioned when Carl steals the eponymous clandestine jetpack for [[The Truth]].
|-
|[[File:ScottWilson-GTASA.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[Scott Wilson]]'''
|Scott Wilson is a deceased resident of [[Palomino Creek]] and also a Rockstar employee listed in the credits as a 'countryside artist'. His tombstone can be found in the graveyard for the [[Drive-Thru Confession Church]].

Despite this, she again becomes romantically involved with Martinez.<br />''She is voiced by Sara Moon''.

He later becomes romantically involved with MacIntyre.<br />''He is voiced by [[wp:Frank Chavez|Frank Chavez]]''.<br />''He also appears in: [[Grand Theft Auto III]], [[Grand Theft Auto: Vice City]] and [[Grand Theft Auto: Vice City Stories]].''

|'''[[Officer Carver]]'''
|Officer Carver is a deleted character from [[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]]. He was to be an opponent of [[Frank Tenpenny]] and [[Eddie Pulaski]], who would order Carl Johnson to kill him in the mission [[Doberman]].
|-
|[[File:MarcoForelli-GTASA.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[Marco Forelli]]'''
|Marco Forelli is a deleted character from [[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]]. He was a high ranking mobster in the [[Forelli Family]] who [[Carl Johnson]] was to kill in the mission [[Saint Mark's Bistro]]. The mission and character remain unchanged, although there is no mention of Marco Forelli.
|-
|'''[[Larry]]'''
|Larry is a deleted character from [[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]]. He was to be a [[HPV-1000|motorcycle]] [[Las Venturas Police Department|police officer]] who had his bike stolen in the mission [[Cop Wheels]].
|-
|'''[[Poncho]]'''
|Poncho is a deleted character from [[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]]. He was to be an ally of [[Frank Tenpenny]] and [[Eddie Pulaski]]. He was going to be arrested by [[Officer Carver]] with Tenpenny and Pulaski sending Carl Johnson to kill Carver, believing Poncho would talk. This was to take place in the mission [[Doberman]].
